module: "Objectives / Career Setup" panel of the mission editor. It configures the mission's stars (starsActive, defaultStarKeys for the 3 default stars, bonus stars), the rewards per star (starRewards: attributeKey + rewardAmount) and the ending texts (starOutroTexts, with default translation). It also contains checks (getMissionIssues) and a "Raw" JSON mode. Loads the career_branches extension to offer the reward attributes (money, beamXP, vouchers, plus the branches' attributeKey). The module returns a constructor: require(...)(missionEditor).
notes: Bug: Raw mode calls pushStyle("red") and popStyle() which are not defined in this file (nil globals); a JSON error in the raw editor would therefore cause a Lua error when the message is displayed.

getMissionIssues: "Star X using default translations" (minor), "has no text and no default" or "is not translated" (error), "No Stars set at all!" (error if showInCareer, otherwise warning), reward at 0 (error, only if showInCareer).
Checking a star assigns it to the first free slot among the 3 default stars; unchecking it removes it from those slots.
The "Summary" stats add up rewardAmount per attributeKey for all stars, default stars and bonus stars.

C.desc: Instance of the Objectives panel. Fields: missionEditor, mission, missionInstance (gameplay_missions_missions.getMissionById), careerSetup, attributeOptions, skillOptions, copiedStars (clipboard per mission type), starKeysSorted.

init.desc: Constructor: loads career_branches and builds the attributeOptions and skillOptions lists (branches with isSkill).

getMissionIssues.desc: Calls setMission(m) then returns the mission's star, text and reward issues.

setMission.desc: Sets the current mission, gets its game instance, the sorted star keys and the mission type's editor (setContainer(mission, 'mission')).

getStarLabel.desc: Returns the star's translated label (_tr), handling labels as a function, a string or a table {txt}.

drawDefaultStar.desc: Combo to choose which active star occupies the given default star slot. Not called in this file.

returns.desc: Attribute key chosen this frame, otherwise nil.

drawAttributeInput.desc: Text field + combo for a reward's attributeKey; updates re.attributeKey.

drawRewardAmount.desc: Integer field for rewardAmount; also remembers _originalRewardAmount.

drawAddReward.desc: Controls for adding a reward (text, combo, +) and copy/paste buttons for the rewards.

returns.desc: New list if it changed, otherwise nil.

drawStarRewards.desc: Displays and edits a star's rewards list (deletion via "Rem" button, addition).

starSlotSelector.desc: Combo to place the star as "Bonus Star" or as "Default Star N".

drawOutroText.desc: Edit row for a star's ending text (or "noStarUnlocked"), with status icons for the default translation and the current translation.

drawCareerSetup.desc: Draws the whole configuration: list of stars with checkboxes, slot, type editor, rewards, ending texts, then summary (default stars, bonus, reward totals).

draw.desc: Draws the "Career Setup" header (Raw checkbox, copy/paste of the configuration per mission type) then drawCareerSetup or the raw JSON editor of mission.careerSetup.
